title: skills(objectstack-data): audit sealing still teaches one checkpoint per organization-hour; #33637 seals into parts of at most 10,000 rows
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyNkH7W7e89m6j4aQq

Filing gate: **② a finding from a dispatched card.** review#3 on #33637 (record 6891899947, M1) found that two skill files still teach the sealing cut that #33637 (Part of #31908, ADR-0154 D4 as amended in #33489) replaces. Skills are edited only on domain:skills PRs, so #33637 declares `Skills-docs: follow-up #<this card>`.

## Maintainer quick read

- Problem: the `objectstack-data` skill tells authors that each sealed hour becomes one checkpoint per organization, and (in older text) that no verifier exists. After #33637, a window seals into consecutive checkpoints of at most 10,000 rows, and `os audit verify` faults a row two checkpoints list (`listed_twice`).
- To do: update the two passages to match `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx` and `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` as changed in #33637.
- Needed from you: nothing; the skills lane picks it up.

## Where

- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` around line 278 (graded `expected_output`: "one checkpoint per organization", and the "no verifier exists" text).
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` lines 131-133 (one checkpoint per organization) and 164-166 (no verifier).

## Done when

- Both files say a sealed hour is one checkpoint, or consecutive checkpoints of at most 10,000 rows, per organization chain plus the deployment chain; and that `os audit verify` exists and fails on a chain fault (including `listed_twice`).
- The skills token ratchet and eval schema gates stay green; `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset.

Blocked-by: #33637 (land the behaviour first).
Related: #31908, #33489, #33637.
